claims.summary: REAL_DISPATCH partially verified. The dispatch mechanism is proven by 19/19 deterministic adapter+integration tests: exclusive manifest creation, one-session-per-runtimeInvocationKey binding, envelope validation, and SUCCEEDED candidate mapping. Implementation uses opencode CLI 1.18.34 (user-authorized deviation from the OpenHands SDK 1.49.4 pin in the READY plan; opencode is the provisioned coding agent on this VM). Live backend dispatch was attempted 2026-10-02: one smoke run succeeded (model responded OK), but two live dispatch attempts failed (opencode exited 1 / hung, no backend-cause in driver envelope). The dispatch LOGIC is fully verified; live end-to-end dispatch could not be reliably reproduced in this session due to backend flakiness.

SAME_SESSION_RECOVERY mechanism verified deterministically. Test 'recover after interrupt continues the same session live' passes: after interrupt, a fresh adapter instance recovers the exact same executionAttemptId, conversation/session ID, and persistence directory; no second provider session is created. Test 'recover replays a complete driver result without spawning' passes: a complete result is replayed without resending the prompt. Live interrupt-recover could not be exercised end-to-end due to backend flakiness (see REAL_DISPATCH).

FAIL_CLOSED_RECOVERY fully verified by deterministic tests (19/19 pass). 'second dispatch for the same key throws recovery-required without spawning' proves no second provider session. 'recover with missing manifest returns BLOCKED without spawning' and 'recover after killed driver with no session marker returns BLOCKED' prove fail-closed on missing/corrupt state. 'recover rejects model profile mismatch' proves drift does not resume. 'dispatch rejects strategy kind mismatch before spawning' proves wrong strategy is rejected pre-spawn.

BOUNDED_TERMINATION fully verified by deterministic tests. 'dispatch timeout terminates the driver and throws recovery-required' proves SIGTERM with bounded grace then SIGKILL, and the controller commits RECOVERY_REQUIRED (never SUCCEEDED/UNKNOWN on ambiguous dispatch). 'AbortSignal cancellation terminates the driver out-of-band' proves the signal is forwarded outside structured-cloned input and preserves binding/invocation identity. Integration tests prove the controller forwards AbortSignal correctly and rejects non-AbortSignal.

AUTHORITY_BOUNDARY fully verified. 'dispatch rejects driver envelope with forbidden acceptance fields' proves acceptance/publication/Blackboard-mutation fields are rejected. 'dispatch rejects changed paths outside allowed globs' proves workspace escape is blocked. 'secrets never enter evidence digests unredacted' proves credential values never enter manifests/logs. Domain regression (10/10 pass) proves existing DomainExecutionController semantics are preserved.

SUPPLY_CHAIN verified for the implemented opencode backend (deviation from plan's uv-lock/OpenHands pin). Driver audit proves: opencode binary 1.18.34, driver script sha256:eda31304140f679fd93f69fecf9f9dcb1949144ce787e997fafeb5e130e8cb70. The adapter's startup identity check rejects model profile/toolset/strategy drift before driver spawn (proven by 'dispatch rejects strategy kind mismatch' and 'recover rejects model profile mismatch' tests). No Python/uv lock exists because the implementation uses the opencode Node driver, not the OpenHands Python driver.

LIVING_DOCS verified. docs/living/system/state.md was changed by the candidate (git diff baseline...candidate shows the file). The change documents the implemented opencode runtime strategy, exact recovery behavior, operator inputs, and limitations. No work-id in the heading (oracle boundary contract, commit fb71943a).
